question: 売上の最初の見積もりと確定値は、どれくらい違った？

attempts.llm:
```sql
WITH first_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        SUM(revenue_amount) AS initial_amount
    FROM main_mart.fct_revenue AS r
    WHERE snapshot_date = (
        SELECT MIN(snapshot_date)
        FROM main_mart.fct_revenue AS r2
        WHERE r2.revenue_month = r.revenue_month
    )
    GROUP BY revenue_month
),
final_snapshot AS (
    SELECT
        revenue_month,
        SUM(revenue_amount) AS final_amount
    FROM main_mart.fct_revenue
    WHERE is_finalized = TRUE
      AND is_latest_snapshot = TRUE
    GROUP BY revenue_month
)
SELECT
    f.revenue_month,
    i.initial_amount,
    f.final_amount,
    (f.final_amount - i.initial_amount) AS diff_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN i.initial_amount = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (f.final_amount - i.initial_amount) * 100.0 / i.initial_amount
    END AS diff_pct
FROM final_snapshot AS f
LEFT JOIN first_snapshot AS i USING (revenue_month)
ORDER BY f.revenue_month;
```
